description:
HARBOUR RESIDENCE | SEA BREEZE

Sea views and the elegant architecture of harbor towns

Premium living and a distinctive lifestyle on the shores of the Caspian Sea

Located in a picturesque part of Sea Breeze, Harbour Residence combines the architectural aesthetics of select harbor towns from around the world with a modern living concept. Panoramic views of the sea and the coastal city of the future, along with spacious terraces and leisure amenities, lend a unique character to the project.

PROJECT HIGHLIGHTS:

- Scenic location with a coastal town atmosphere
- Spacious terraces and the option for a private pool
- Large swimming pool, cafes, and restaurants
- Underground and surface parking
- Handover in shell-and-core condition – allowing you to design the interior to your personal taste

PRIVILEGES FOR SEA BREEZE RESIDENTS:

By owning a property at Harbour Residence, you gain access to exclusive benefits reserved for Sea Breeze residents:

- Access to the beach club and swimming pools
- Special discounts at restaurants and bars
- Discounts on concerts and festivals
- Discounts at the Anti-Aging Center
- Sports infrastructure featuring indoor and outdoor pools, fitness centers, and saunas
- Tennis, football, and basketball courts

SEA BREEZE | A RESIDENTIAL ENVIRONMENT DEFINED BY ITS SCALE:

Located on the Caspian coast, Sea Breeze Resort is a large-scale resort and residential community spanning over 500 hectares. It encompasses more than 40 completed or ongoing projects, 50 restaurants, cafes, and bars, 60 swimming pools, various social amenities, over 7 km of landscaped beach, and 300 hectares of green space.

RESIDENTIAL AND INVESTMENT OPPORTUNITY:

Harbour Residence is an option suitable for both personal residence and long-term real estate investment. Renting out the apartment through a management company can provide an opportunity to generate additional income. The actual return, however, depends on rental demand and the terms of the agreement.
